typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFolder as string (),
	EndDate as timestamp (),
	ExportFile as string (),
	ExportSQL as string (),
	ExtractType as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	OutboundFolder as string (),
	OverrideFileName as string (),
	StartDate as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'User::ExportSQL',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Column_0 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Column_0 = ResultSet)) ~> FlatFileDestination
